# DSpace@MIT

> MIT's institutional digital repository providing open access to scholarly articles, theses, research publications, and course materials across all MIT schools and laboratories.

DSpace@MIT is the official open-access repository for Massachusetts Institute of Technology, built on the DSpace platform. It serves as a central hub for discovering, accessing, and preserving MIT's research output including peer-reviewed articles, graduate theses, working papers, and archived OpenCourseWare materials.

## Core Collections

- [MIT Open Access Articles](https://dspace.mit.edu/handle/1721.1/49433): MIT Faculty Open Access Policy collection of peer-reviewed scholarly articles
- [MIT Theses](https://dspace.mit.edu/handle/1721.1/7582): MIT Theses digital archive: dissertations and thesis repository via DSpace
- [MIT OCW Archived Courses](https://dspace.mit.edu/handle/1721.1/33971): MIT OpenCourseWare archived courses under Creative Commons license

## Laboratory & School Collections

- [Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence Lab (CSAIL)](https://dspace.mit.edu/handle/1721.1/5458): CSAIL digital archive: AI and computer science research publications
- [Sloan School of Management](https://dspace.mit.edu/handle/1721.1/1777): Sloan School research collection: working papers and management theses
- [Laboratory for Information and Decision Systems (LIDS)](https://dspace.mit.edu/handle/1721.1/1775): LIDS repository: technical reports on control systems and signal processing

## Discovery & Access

- [DSpace@MIT Home](https://dspace.mit.edu): DSpace@MIT homepage: MIT's digital repository for open access articles and theses
- [Search](https://dspace.mit.edu/discover): Search interface for discovering MIT research across DSpace collections
- [Browsing by Issue Date](https://dspace.mit.edu/browse): Browse DSpace@MIT research papers and documents by publication date
